entities.name: Wallis Parrish
entities.description: A pirate captain and mind-mage of the former Deadeye Fleet of the Brazen Coalition on Ixalan, who presumably later led the Bluecoats.

entities.name: Deadeye Fleet
entities.description: A fleet of captains of the Brazen Coalition who once served in the naval forces of the Free Cities and preferred infiltration, assassination and thievery.

entities.name: Bluecoats
entities.description: The former Deadeyes, restored to the status of a national navy by Governor Brass, who enforce the Brazen Coalition's cosmium prospecting deeds.

entities.name: Brazen Coalition
entities.description: The pirate coalition of Ixalan that settled the coast after the invasion and is being legitimized as a state.

entities.name: Tide Turner
entities.description: The ship commanded by Captain Wallis Parrish.

entities.name: Dire Fleet
entities.description: A pirate fleet that, unlike the Deadeyes, sailed together as a formidable force.

entities.name: Brass
entities.description: The newly appointed governor of the Brazen Coalition, who seeks to legitimize it as a state.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion that upended the old order on Ixalan and devastated Atzocan.

entities.name: Atzocan
entities.description: A place on Ixalan devastated by the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane where the Brazen Coalition and the Imperials contend.

events.summary: Parrish commands the Tide Turner and secures the conditional loyalty of other Deadeye captains.
events.quote: Captain Wallis Parrish commanded the Tide Turner

events.summary: Parrish keeps the captains loyal by controlling information and handing out tips, in exchange for a share of spoils.
events.quote: Captain Parrish kept the other captains loyal to her by controlling the flow of information

events.summary: The New Phyrexian Invasion devastates Atzocan and depopulates much of the coast.
events.quote: The New Phyrexian Invasion upended the old order, devastating Atzocan and depopulating much of the coast.

events.summary: Governor Brass returns the former Deadeyes to the status of a national navy, the Bluecoats.
events.quote: the former Deadeyes returned to their old status as a national navy by Governor Brass

relations.note: Her flag unites the Deadeye captains.
relations.quote: a handful of other captains who sail under Parrish's flag as part of a fleet called the Deadeyes

relations.note: The Deadeye Fleet is part of the Brazen Coalition.
relations.quote: pirate commander of the former Deadeye Fleet of the Brazen Coalition on Ixalan

relations.note: Brass returned the former Deadeyes to national navy status as the Bluecoats.
relations.quote: the former Deadeyes returned to their old status as a national navy by Governor Brass
